verdict.rationale: LocalAI is built to be self-hosted. The docs show running it via `docker run` or as a single binary that serves an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost:8080, with a built-in web UI. They also cover CPU-only operation, multi-user auth, and distributed GPU worker nodes, and the source is on GitHub. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world self-hosted deployments.
